codeReview.summary: Commit a3de621 satisfies the feature contract for VAL-BUNDLE-003. The only source change moves the `window.sidePanelUI` assignment so it always runs in normal sidepanel builds, preserving the automation entrypoints used by `tests/e2e/run-e2e.ts` and `scripts/capture-screenshots.ts`, while the perf-monitor dynamic import and startup remain gated behind `__PERF_DEBUG__`. The built sidepanel bundle still omits the removed perf debug string, and I did not find scoped correctness issues in the reviewed implementation.
